column3: Locked tight. Nobody's\nanswering from inside.{end_wait}
The branches are bent\nlike they're praying.{end_wait}
Welcome to Vault. Don't\nmind the ash. It gets\neverywhere.{end_wait}
Wasn't that eruption\nsomething to see?{end_now}
I haven't slept since.\nEvery night, I smell\nthe smoke.{end_wait}
Not even scared? Then\nyou're braver than me.\nOr you hide it well.{end_wait}

Master Hammet, the rich
merchant from Kalay...
his rod was stolen.{page_break}He's not the only one
who lost something that
night. He's just loud.{end_wait}
Some people used the\neruption to rob their\nneighbors. Vulture work.{end_wait}
His servant can't go\nback to Kalay without\nthat rod. Poor kid.{end_wait}

Those travelers left in
such a hurry.{page_break}Like they were running
from something. Did you
see them come in?{end_now}

No, not Hammet's people.
Six of them. Two women,
four men.{page_break}Strange lot. Dressed for
travel, but not like
merchants.{page_break}The girl and the old man
walked like prisoners.
Nobody said a word.{end_wait}
Oh... maybe they left\nbefore I thought.\nGood. I hope.{end_wait}
That poor boy, {actor_name:3}.{page_break}Left at the mayor's to\nlook for a stolen rod.\nHe's just a child.{end_wait}

Hammet's caravan packed
up the second the ground
stopped shaking...{page_break}Can't blame him. I'd run
too, if I had a cart.{end_wait}

Nobody here stole
anything. I'd stake my
life on it.{page_break}It's strangers. Always
strangers. Look at who
came through town.{page_break}Not us. It can't be us.
Not in Vault.{end_wait}
Are you accusing us of\ntaking Hammet's rod?\nChoose your words.{end_now}
Just because we're new\ndoesn't make us thieves!{page_break}You've got no proof.\nNone!{end_wait}

Ha! Knew you were too
smart for the rumors.{page_break}It wasn't us. We don't
even know what was
taken, honest.{end_wait}
An adventure, is it?\nWith the world like\nthis?{end_now}
Young ones like you,\nwalking into danger.\nI don't envy you.{end_wait}
Stop by our Sanctum\nbefore you go. Pray, if\nyou're the praying kind.{end_wait}
Ruff! Rrruff...{end_wait}
These{pause_20_skippable} children...\nstuck here till the\nmountain settles.{end_wait}
Aleph's eruption...\nthere are no words.{page_break}We lived. Why did we\nlive? Others didn't.{end_wait}

Why's a rich man like
Hammet so frantic over
one rod?{page_break}He could buy ten more.
Unless it's not just a
rod...{end_wait}
Stealing while the sky\nwas on fire. A man who\ndoes that has no soul.{end_wait}
Poor {actor_name:3}...{pause_20_skippable}\nIf the rod never turns up,\nhe's stuck here for good.{end_wait}
I'd bet those three at\nthe inn took the rod.\nSomething's off with them.{end_wait}
Doesn't matter how rich\nyou are...{page_break}A volcano doesn't care\nabout your gold.{end_wait}
Everyone knows it was\nthose three at the inn.{page_break}And nobody does a thing!\nIt makes me sick!!{end_wait}
Tch. They're onto us.{page_break}Time to leave town.\nQuietly. Tonight.{end_wait}
I was about to leave\nthis town for good when\nthe mountain blew.{end_wait}
Stealing while the\nmountain burned...{page_break}People love money more\nthan their own lives.{end_wait}
A burning rock tore\nthrough the roof.{page_break}And who has to patch it?\nMe, as always.{end_wait}
Fix the roof? Pay a\ncarpenter? Please.{page_break}A hammer and some nails.\nHow hard can it be?{end_wait}

He should be fixing the
roof, but he's nowhere.{page_break}Hiding in back, I'd bet.
Slacking, while we sit
under a hole.{end_wait}
That sneak! Off wasting\ntime while the roof\nstays open to the sky!{end_wait}
Whoa, {actor_name:1}'s Psynergy\nmoves things? Where\ndid you learn that?{end_wait}
You're leaving? I still\nworry about the rod.{page_break}I'll wait here until\nyou two come back.{end_wait}
You're back! Good.\nLet's find that rod.{end_wait}
It's still a crime,\neven if you return it.{page_break}Even if you're really,\nreally sorry.{end_wait}
Oh... wait. I can't take\nyour Djinni with me.{page_break}I'll leave it with\n{actor_name:1}. Be quick.{end_wait}
On the road again, are\nyou? Already?{end_now}
You'll always have a bed\nhere in Vault. Always.{end_wait}
You say that now...\nbut you'll leave anyway.\nThey all do.{end_wait}
Smoke's still coming off\nAleph. I think it's not\ndone with us yet.{end_wait}
Hammet, the merchant...\nthey say he never made it\nto Kalay.{end_wait}
Thank the gods you got\nthose thieves.{end_wait}
You mean {actor_name:3}, the\nservant? He went to Lunpa.\nAlone.{end_wait}
I see, {actor_name:3}... so\nHammet couldn't be saved.\nI'm sorry.{end_wait}

The eruption wrecked the
roads all over Angara.{page_break}When the southern bridge
is mended, Kalay opens
up again.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} wouldn't go to\nLunpa alone. Would he?{end_wait}
Ha... I shouldn't have\nworried about {actor_name:3}.{page_break}When did he join you,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
Everyone's grateful you\ncaught the thieves.\nThey sleep easier now.{end_wait}
Those men you caught...\nthey're locked up now?{end_now}
Hasn't been used in\nyears, that jail. Feels\nwrong, somehow.{end_wait}

They're angry, saying
awful things in there.
It's sad, really.{page_break}Maybe go talk to them.
While you still can.{end_wait}
You... you caught those\nthieves, didn't you?{end_now}
I wish more young people\nhad your sense of honor.\nThe world needs it.{end_wait}
So brave, and so humble.{page_break}Young ones should learn\nfrom you. Before the\nworld teaches them.{end_wait}
Ruff!{pause_20_skippable} Rrruff...{end_wait}
You've brought peace to\nVault, at last...{page_break}I wish you'd stay.\nI don't want to be alone.{end_wait}
Aleph's quieter now.\nI'm going up to the crater.\nI have to see it.{end_wait}
Of all places... why'd\nHammet go to Lunpa?{page_break}I'll never understand\nrich people.{end_wait}

How should we punish
our prisoners?{page_break}Shame them in the
square? Or something
worse?{end_wait}
Nobody enters Lunpa but\nthieves and their victims.{page_break}Give up on Hammet.\nHe's gone.{end_wait}
With the road out, the\nonly way is the cave\nin the Goma Range.{end_wait}
Where did {actor_name:3} go\nall alone? I'm sick\nwith worry.{end_wait}
Wait. When did they\nmeet up with {actor_name:3}?{end_wait}
You must be stronger\nthan you look. Catching\nthose thieves...{end_wait}
I can breathe again.\nThose thieves are behind\nbars at last.{end_wait}
Catching thieves means\na fight. I can't stand\nthat kind of danger.{end_wait}
Bring me a bone.\nI know something useful.\nI'll trade.{end_wait}
Oh... oh!!{end_wait}
Ruff ruff ruff!!!{end_wait}
How did you know I\nwanted this? Thank you.{end_wait}
Thank you for the other\nday. Leaving already?{page_break}I'll pray for your\nsafety. Every night.{end_wait}
Sniff... Cooking meat...{page_break}Nobody's looking. One\nbite won't hurt...{end_wait}

A careful search will
{pause_20_skippable}reveal{pause_20_skippable} a passage leading
underground nearby.{page_break}There may be treasure
down there. Or not.{end_wait}
Bilibin is east of here.{end_wait}
Imil is far to the\nnorth. Cold up there.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} threw the\nswitch. Something clicked\nbeyond the wall.{end_wait}

You! You're the ones who
caught the thieves, aren't
you?{page_break}You came back to Vault.
Thank the gods.{end_wait}
The bridge to Kalay is\nfixed. Not that anyone\ntravels in this rain.{end_wait}
I keep wondering what\nhappened to Hammet in\nLunpa...{end_wait}

Rumors say thieves from
Lunpa are running wild,{page_break}but we've ignored them.
It's easier that way.{page_break}Why have they gone so
quiet lately? That scares
me more.{end_wait}

Oh, it's you. I was just
talking about you with
the mayor.{page_break}You're strong. Let the
thieves come. They'll
regret it.{page_break}They won't get past you.
I hope.{end_wait}
It hasn't stopped raining\nsince the beacon lit.{page_break}The mountain is quiet,\nbut the sky isn't.{end_wait}
Hey, it's that warrior!{end_wait}
Yeah. And {actor_name:3}, too.\nHe looks tired.{end_wait}
Glad you came back.\nVault feels safer with\nyou around.{end_wait}
Nights are longer now.\nI wish Vault's elders\nhad half your courage.{end_wait}
Did you check the jail?\nYou'll want to see it.{end_now}
How did those thugs break\nout? The bars are solid.{page_break}Someone helped them.\nI don't like it.{end_wait}
The thieves broke out\nand got away.{page_break}After everything you did\nto catch them...{end_wait}

The thieves escaped.
The rain will wash
out their tracks.{page_break}Perhaps it's all part
of a plan we can't see.{end_wait}
Bow wow wow wow!!{end_wait}
You're here! Thank the\ngods. Perfect timing.{end_wait}
The men from Kalay who\nfixed the bridge looked{page_break}worried. Like they\nwere afraid of something.{end_wait}

Warriors from Kalay came
to Vault, asking after
Hammet.{page_break}Did something happen
to him after all?{end_wait}

Since Dodonpa took over,
Lunpa's outlaws are no
better than thieves.{page_break}They're quiet for a
reason. I'd bet on it.{end_wait}

Those fools escaped and
we don't know where.{page_break}They hate these kids for
catching them. I wonder
if they'd...{end_wait}
Winter's coming. I wish\nthis were all settled\nbefore it does.{end_wait}

Watching you makes me
feel braver.{page_break}Tell me about your
travels, someday. If you
come back.{end_wait}
Grown-ups panic whenever\nsomething happens.{page_break}I'm so tired of it.\nI hate it.{end_wait}

It isn't easy to get that
jail key.{page_break}They got it out, so they
knew the lock's secret...{page_break}Somebody told them.
Somebody here.{end_wait}
I keep wondering... was\nour statue taken because\nof something{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} I did?{end_wait}
Bring me some bones and\nI'll tell you a secret.{end_wait}
Owwwoooooh...{end_wait}
Bow wow wow!{end_wait}
How did you know I\nwanted this? Thank you.{end_wait}
The roof is fixed, but\nit can't keep the rain\nout of our heads.{end_wait}
That's the last of the\nroof. What now? I don't\nlike being idle.{end_wait}
Water is rumbling far down\nbelow, deep and constant.{end_wait}
